digest: Required boundary tests are absent; only typechecking is configured.

findings.title: 중지·취소·종료 요약 경계 조건을 검증하는 테스트가 없다
findings.evidence: SPEC.md explicitly requires unit tests for every S/C/T requirement, but the repository contains no test files or test script. package.json exposes only typecheck, and tsconfig includes only src/**/*.ts.
evidenceQuotes: - **Q1.** 위 S·C·T 항목마다 그 동작을 확인하는 단위 테스트가 있어야 한다.
findings.rationale: This is a direct verification requirement, not merely a style preference. Without executable tests, critical boundaries such as dispose-versus-in-flight disk reads, exact cancellation classification, recursive content handling, and dynamic terminal fallback cannot be regression-checked or reliably reviewed.
findings.recommendedAction: Add a runnable unit-test command and tests covering each S1-S7, C1-C2, and T1-T3 boundary, including concurrent/in-flight read cases and exact public summary field names.
